events.query: UNWIND $pages AS p CREATE (:Page {doc_id: p.doc_id, page_no: p.page_no, width: p.width, height: p.height})

UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:SectionHeader { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:Paragraph { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:ListItem { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })

UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:TextElement { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:Table { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:Figure { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $batch AS e CREATE (n:Element:List { doc_id: e.doc_id, self_ref: e.self_ref, docling_label: e.docling_label, text: e.text, level: e.level, caption: e.caption, cells_json: e.cells_json })
UNWIND $rows AS r MATCH (p:Element {doc_id: r.doc_id, self_ref: r.parent_ref}) MATCH (c:Element {doc_id: r.doc_id, self_ref: r.child_ref}) MERGE (p)-[rel:PARENT_OF]->(c) SET rel.order = r.order
UNWIND $rows AS r MATCH (d:Document {id: r.doc_id}) MATCH (c:Element {doc_id: r.doc_id, self_ref: r.child_ref}) MERGE (d)-[:HAS_ROOT]->(c)

UNWIND $rows AS r MATCH (e:Element {doc_id: r.doc_id, self_ref: r.self_ref}) CREATE (pv:Provenance { doc_id: r.doc_id, element_ref: r.self_ref, prov_order: r.order, page_no: r.page_no, bbox_l: r.bbox_l, bbox_t: r.bbox_t, bbox_r: r.bbox_r, bbox_b: r.bbox_b, coord_origin: r.coord_origin, charspan_start: r.charspan_start, charspan_end: r.charspan_end }) CREATE (e)-[:HAS_PROV {order: r.order}]->(pv)

UNWIND $rows AS r WITH r WHERE r.page_no IS NOT NULL MATCH (pv:Provenance { doc_id: r.doc_id, element_ref: r.self_ref, prov_order: r.order }) MATCH (p:Page {doc_id: r.doc_id, page_no: r.page_no}) MERGE (pv)-[:ON_PAGE]->(p)
UNWIND $pairs AS p MATCH (a:Element {doc_id: p.doc_id, self_ref: p.a}) MATCH (b:Element {doc_id: p.doc_id, self_ref: p.b}) MERGE (a)-[:NEXT]->(b)

UNWIND $rows AS r MATCH (c:Chunk {id: r.chunk_id}) MATCH (e:Element {doc_id: r.doc_id, self_ref: r.self_ref}) MERGE (c)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(e)
MATCH (d:Document {id: $doc_id}) SET d.stages_applied = [s IN coalesce(d.stages_applied, []) WHERE s <> 'chunks'] + ['chunks'], d.last_chunk_write = datetime()

events.query: MATCH (d:Document {id: $doc_id}) CALL { WITH d MATCH (e:Element {doc_id: d.id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[hp:HAS_PROV]->(pv:Provenance) WITH e, pv ORDER BY hp.order WITH e, collect( CASE WHEN pv IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE { order: pv.prov_order, page_no: pv.page_no, bbox_l: pv.bbox_l, bbox_t: pv.bbox_t, bbox_r: pv.bbox_r, bbox_b: pv.bbox_b, coord_origin: pv.coord_origin, charspan_start: pv.charspan_start, charspan_end: pv.charspan_end } END ) AS all_provs RETURN collect({element: e, provs: [p IN all_provs WHERE p IS NOT NULL]}) AS elements } CALL { WITH d MATCH (p:Page {doc_id: d.id}) RETURN collect(p) AS pages } CALL { WITH d MATCH (c:Chunk {doc_id: d.id}) RETURN collect(c) AS chunks } CALL { WITH d MATCH (pe:Element {doc_id: d.id})-[r:PARENT_OF]->(ce:Element) RETURN collect({from: pe.self_ref, to: ce.self_ref, order: r.order, type: 'PARENT_OF'}) AS parent_edges } CALL { WITH d MATCH (a:Element {doc_id: d.id})-[:NEXT]->(b:Element) RETURN collect({from: a.self_ref, to: b.self_ref, type: 'NEXT'}) AS next_edges } CALL { WITH d // ON_PAGE is stored on Provenance since v0.6; surface it at the Element // level (dedup'd per Element/Page pair) for the Cytoscape viz. MATCH (er:Element {doc_id: d.id})-[:HAS_PROV]->(:Provenance)-[:ON_PAGE]->(pr:Page) WITH DISTINCT er, pr RETURN collect({from: er.self_ref, to: pr.page_no, type: 'ON_PAGE'}) AS on_page_edges } CALL { WITH d MATCH (d)-[:HAS_ROOT]->(rr:Element) RETURN collect({from: d.id, to: rr.self_ref, type: 'HAS_ROOT'}) AS has_root_edges } CALL { WITH d MATCH (d)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(rc:Chunk) RETURN collect({from: d.id, to: rc.id, type: 'HAS_CHUNK'}) AS has_chunk_edges } CALL { WITH d MATCH (cc:Chunk {doc_id: d.id})-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(ee:Element) RETURN collect({from: cc.id, to: ee.self_ref, type: 'DERIVED_FROM'}) AS derived_from_edges } RETURN d AS document, elements, pages, chunks, parent_edges, next_edges, on_page_edges, has_root_edges, has_chunk_edges, derived_from_edges
